# Narrative

> Narrative is an AI-powered photo culling and editing platform designed for photographers to streamline workflows with intelligent batch processing and Lightroom integration.

Narrative provides photographers with AI-assisted tools for selecting and editing photos at scale. The platform features advanced capabilities like face detection, scene recognition, and customizable presets, with seamless integration into existing Lightroom workflows.

## Key Topics

- Photo Culling
- AI Photo Editing
- Lightroom Integration
- Face Detection
- Workflow Automation
- AI Presets
- Scenes View
- Close-Ups Panel
- Face Assessments
- Wedding Photography
- Batch Processing
- Image Management
- RAW Support
- Personal Presets
- Photographer Tools

## Core Products

- [Narrative | AI Photo Culling and Editing Software](https://narrative.so): Homepage introducing Narrative AI photo culling and editing software with Lightroom integration

- [Narrative | Best AI Photo Editing Software | Photographers](https://narrative.so/edit): Narrative Edit: AI-powered photo editing with batch processing and Lightroom integration

## Culling Features

- [Narrative | For Photographers | Scenes View](https://narrative.so/select/scenes-view): Scenes View feature for AI-driven photo ranking and batch processing in Narrative
- [Best Culling Feature for Photographers | Close-Ups Panel](https://narrative.so/select/the-close-ups-panel): Close-Ups Panel feature for instant face detection and photo selection decisions
- [Narrative | For Photographers | Face Assessments](https://narrative.so/select/face-assessments): Face Assessments feature using AI focus detection for optimal photo culling
